scenario: [LGRA.23.2]: only an `Int`, `Float`, `String` or `Bool` kwarg takes a builtin `default`; a kwarg of any other builtin type -- `Bytes`, `Date`, `Duration`, `Interval`, `Json` or `Time` -- takes none. `kwarg b: Bytes default "ab"` is refused with DS_VALIDATE_SERVICE_KWARG_DEFAULT_TYPE, though a String literal is one the parser takes after `default`. `LGRA.23.2_time_default_refused` is the same rule on a `Time` kwarg with a number. PATH PINNED: `lgra_23_2_default_misfit`'s `te_builtin(_)` arm for a type that is not one of the four, in dsc.validate. Without that arm the program compiles and the encoder writes `has_default` with an empty `default_value`.
rules_ds:
service svc.foo:
    kwarg b: Bytes default "ab"
    no response
